title: Lena and the Letter
author: Rafael Quintana
blurb: Marguerite Underhill, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
